entities.summary: Robert Lichton (1631–1692), also Leighton, Lichtoun, Lichtone, Lyton, Lord of Ulishaven, Forfarshire, Scotland and Lord of Tervik, was a Lieutenant General in the Swedish Army and President of the Superior Court of Justice (hovrätt) at Åbo (Turku).
